crossRefs.note: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and…
When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.
He left everything, and rose up and followed him.
When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have, and distribute it to…
But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.
Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”
But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira, his wife, sold a possession,
saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”
However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.
Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord…
for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to…
Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, isn’t the Father’s…

translations.web: So therefore whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.
translations.bsb: In the same way, any one of you who does not give up everything he has cannot be My disciple.
translations.kjv: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.
translations.asv: So therefore whosoever he be of you that renounceth not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.
